summary: A link styled as a button, for a call or the next step.

props.name: href
props.description: A site path, or tel: or mailto: built from site.phone or site.email.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible text, read from a site field.

props.name: variant
props.description: primary for the one main action, secondary for the rest.

constraints: Renders nothing when href or label is empty.
At most one primary per group of actions.
forbidden: a literal label, phone number or email address
a link to a page not in src/pages

summary: Phone, email, weekday hours and service area as a labelled list.
constraints: Reads site.phone, site.email, site.weekdayHours and site.serviceAreaText (else site.serviceArea) itself; each row renders only when its field is set.
forbidden: passing contact details as props or children

summary: A closing band with a heading, a line and the site's main action.
constraints: Reads ctaHeading, ctaBody and ctaLabel; renders nothing until the heading or the body is set. The links come from the pages that exist and the phone fact. An empty ctaLabel takes the label of the page it links to, which is the quote page when there is one.
Last on a page, after everything else.
forbidden: an offer, discount or deadline

summary: Questions and answers, each one a native disclosure that needs no script.
constraints: Reads faq1Question to faq3Answer itself; an entry needs both halves to render.
forbidden: an answer stating a price, hour or guarantee no fact carries

summary: The owner's photos, each with the alt text its fact gives.
constraints: Path and alt text are both fact fields; a photo renders only when it has both. The site ships with none.
forbidden: a path or alt text written here
a stock or remote image

summary: The page's h1 with an optional lede and action links as children.

props.name: heading
props.description: The page's h1, read from a site field.

props.name: lede
props.description: One sentence under the heading, read from a site field.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short line above the heading, such as the industry, from a site field.

props.name: variant
props.description: split for the home page, compact for a page header, centered otherwise.

constraints: One per page, first inside the layout.
Children are ActionLink elements only.
split for the home page, compact for a page under it, centered otherwise.
Renders nothing when the heading, the lede and the actions are all empty.
eyebrow is for the home page, with site.industry.
forbidden: a second Hero on a page
literal text in heading or lede

summary: The quote request form, the visitor's contact details and then the owner's own questions.
constraints: Asks for name, email and phone, labelled by quoteNameLabel, quoteEmailLabel and quotePhoneLabel, then the questions in src/quote-form.json under quoteRequestLegend.
src/quote-form.json is the list the owner approved. The platform writes it; never edit it or this file to change the questions.
Sends to quoteFormAction when set, else by email to site.email; renders nothing with neither. Leave quoteFormAction empty until the platform gives an endpoint.
On the quote page, after its Hero.
forbidden: a price, a range or a promise of how soon a reply comes
a field asking for payment or card details
a script or a third-party form service

summary: A titled block of page content below the hero.

props.name: heading
props.description: The section's h2, read from a site field.

constraints: Wrap it in the condition its content needs, so an empty section never renders.
forbidden: a Section with no content
literal text in heading

summary: The page head, with title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph and JSON-LD.

props.name: title
props.description: The page's own title; the business name is appended.

props.name: description
props.description: The meta and Open Graph description, read from a site field.

props.name: jsonLd
props.description: Items from src/structured-data.ts; the schema.org context is added here.

props.name: noindex
props.description: Keeps the page out of search results, as the 404 page does.

constraints: The Base layout renders it; a page passes these props to Base.
JSON-LD comes from src/structured-data.ts and is LocalBusiness, Service or WebSite only.
forbidden: using it outside the Base layout
JSON-LD built outside src/structured-data.ts
ratings, reviews or aggregateRating

summary: The services on offer, as cards of a name and a sentence.
constraints: Reads service1Name to service3Body itself; a card renders only when one of its two fields is set.
No prices anywhere. The site quotes on request, through the quote page.
forbidden: a price
a service the facts give no sign of

summary: The footer with business name, contact details and navigation.
constraints: The Base layout renders it on every page.
Every part comes from a field and vanishes when that field is empty.
forbidden: using it in a page

summary: The header with business name, navigation and one call to action.
constraints: The Base layout renders it on every page.
Navigation and the action come from src/routes.ts, so a link shows only when its page exists and its label field is set.
forbidden: using it in a page
a hard-coded navigation link

summary: Up to three figures about the business, each one a fact.
constraints: Reads statYearsValue, statClientsValue and statRatingValue, which are fact fields, and their labels, which are not. A figure with no value does not render, label or no label.
forbidden: a figure no fact states

summary: How working with the business goes, as numbered steps.
constraints: Reads step1Title to step3Body itself; a step renders only when one of its two fields is set. The numbers are drawn by CSS, not written into a field.
forbidden: a time, price or promise no fact states

summary: Reviews quoted from the facts, with the reviewer's name.
constraints: Quote and author are both fact fields. A quote is rendered as the fact gives it, unedited and untrimmed.
forbidden: a review written here
editing or shortening a quote

summary: Up to three reasons to choose the business, each a title and a sentence.
constraints: Reads valueProp1Title to valueProp3Body itself, in order; an entry renders only when one of its two fields is set.
Renders nothing when all six fields are empty.
forbidden: a number, rating, award or guarantee no fact states
